explanation_full: The feature ranking analysis identifies VFA as the most important feature (score: 0.7931), followed by Butyrate (0.7902) and Acetate (0.7772). Model performance metrics show that KNN is the best model, achieving an R² of 0.81717 and an MSE of 0.012810. Furthermore, the incremental feature analysis confirms that the model benefits from a larger feature set, with the KNN score reaching 0.817859 when all 11 features are included. These results highlight the importance of the top three features and the overall benefit of comprehensive feature inclusion.
